0022600208.text: The Nuggets (4-3, 9th in the West, 4th in the Northwest and 2 games back) are on a one-game winning streak and have gone 2-1 on the road, while the Rockets (7-2, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) have won their last ten... more precisely, they are 7-2 over their last nine and coming off a loss. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, and Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Denver won the 2025-26 series 3-1 and beat Houston 129-93 in Denver on March 11, 2026.
